parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS event
)
INSERT INTO access.messages (
  event_id,
  source,
  workspace_id,
  channel_id,
  author_id,
  message_ts,
  thread_ts,
  sanitized_text,
  security_flags,
  status
)
SELECT
  event->>'event_id',
  event->>'source',
  event->>'workspace_id',
  event->>'channel_id',
  event->>'author_id',
  event->>'message_ts',
  event->>'thread_ts',
  event->>'text',
  event->'security_flags',
  'pending'
FROM input
ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id AS message_id, event_id, status;
